subject: Unexpected off-hours ingestion — request for usage reclassification and credit
messages:
From: BrightBuild Billing <billing@brightbuild.com>
To: rishi@redwood.com
Cc: olivia@brightbuild.com
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected off-hours ingestion — request for usage reclassification and credit

Hi Rishi,

We're seeing a large, unexpected spike on our June 4–5 invoice: ~12.8M tokens attributed to our account between 02:00–03:30 UTC. This usage is outside normal business hours and wasn't generated by our product traffic — appears to be test/replay activity from one of our dev machines.

Can you provide:
- A per-request breakdown (request_id, timestamp, model, input_tokens, output_tokens) for the spike window
- Any evidence tying those requests to a session or API key marked as a test/dev environment
- Options for pro-rated credit or reclassification to a non-billable test environment

We also ask Redwood to hold the invoice line item while this is investigated; we will escalate internally if we do not receive confirmation within 48 hours.

Attachments: brightbuild-session-logs-20270605.log (sample from our side)

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Head of Finance, BrightBuild Inc
billing@brightbuild.com
From: rishi@redwood.com <rishi@redwood.com>
To: BrightBuild Billing <billing@brightbuild.com>
Cc: marissa@redwood.com, ben@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected off-hours ingestion — request for usage reclassification and credit

Hi Olivia,

Thanks for the heads-up and for the logs — we can investigate. I've looped in Marissa (AE) and Ben (billing) to coordinate the audit and the invoice hold.

Immediate plan:
- Ben will run a token-level export for 2027-06-04 22:00 UTC through 2027-06-05 04:00 UTC and look for matching request_ids and API keys.
- We'll compare Redwood request metadata (ip, api_key_id, client_user_agent, request_tags) to your logs.
- Finance will place a temporary hold on the disputed line item pending confirmation.

If you can, point to any request_ids in your attached log that you think are test runs — that will speed things up. We'll aim to respond with an initial analysis within 24 hours.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
From: ben@redwood.com <ben@redwood.com>
To: rishi@redwood.com, marissa@redwood.com
Cc: BrightBuild Billing <billing@brightbuild.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected off-hours ingestion — request for usage reclassification and credit

Folks — initial export attached: redwood-usage-snapshot-20270605.csv (CSV: request_id, timestamp_utc, api_key_id, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, client_ip, request_tags)

Summary of findings (quick):
- Total tokens in disputed window (22:00 UTC 6/4 — 04:00 UTC 6/5): 12,882,000 total_tokens.
- Top API key (api_key_id: key_ak_7f3) accounted for 92% of that volume; request_tags column is largely empty but client_user_agent shows repeated calls from a CI agent string (curl/7.76.0) and client_ip 34.112.18.9 (cloud VM).
- BrightBuild's attached sample logs reference request_id: rb-ff12a4 which matches three requests in our export — timestamps align to 02:13:22–02:13:45 UTC.

Interpretation: evidence consistent with a replay/test harness (high token counts per request and repeated identical parameters). Not enough tags to automatically reclassify as non-billable; however, given the evidence and your supplied logs, I recommend issuing a provisional credit for the portion that looks like a dev/test replay.

Proposed provisional credit math:
- Disputed volume attributable to replay (estimated): 12,800,000 tokens
- Unit rate: $0.00025 per token
- Provisional credit: 12,800,000 * 0.00025 = $3,200.00 (round-truncated for provisional note)

Next steps:
1) Confirm you want a provisional credit of $3,200 while we continue a deeper audit (we can hold the disputed invoice line until final resolution).
2) If BrightBuild provides evidence that requests use a known non-production API key or env=test tag for the entire disputed window, we will convert the provisional credit to a full adjustment.
3) If not, we'll finalize a partial credit and produce an audit report for records.

I'll attach a draft credit note once you confirm.

— Ben Carter
Billing Lead | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
From: BrightBuild Billing <billing@brightbuild.com>
To: ben@redwood.com, rishi@redwood.com
Cc: marissa@redwood.com, olivia@brightbuild.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 07:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected off-hours ingestion — request for usage reclassification and credit

Thanks Ben — we confirm the activity is from an internal QA pipeline that accidentally pointed at prod. The sample logs we sent show the env tag in the header for multiple entries: env=test; request_ids in our log starting with rb-ff12a4 match your export.

Attached: brightbuild-session-logs-20270605.log (full snippet), showing env=test for the problematic runs. We request:
- Provisional credit of $3,200 as proposed
- Immediate hold on the disputed line item on the June invoice pending formal credit issuance
- A signed credit note or invoice adjustment so our AP team can process the correction before the June cycle closes

Please expedite — our AR team has flagged the invoice for hold but will need official documentation.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Head of Finance, BrightBuild Inc
From: rishi@redwood.com <rishi@redwood.com>
To: BrightBuild Billing <billing@brightbuild.com>
Cc: ben@redwood.com, marissa@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected off-hours ingestion — request for usage reclassification and credit

Olivia — thank you for the confirmation and the log attachment.

We will:
- Place a hold on the disputed line item for the June invoice immediately (finance notified).
- Issue a provisional credit of $3,200.00 against the June invoice; Ben will send a draft credit note (attached: proposed-credit-note-20270607.pdf) for your AP records.
- Continue the audit to finalize whether the provisional credit converts to a full adjustment; that will require verification that the api_key_id in question is marked non-production in your systems.

Marissa — please coordinate with the BrightBuild engineering contact to confirm non-prod key mapping so Ben and I can close this out.

Olivia — I'll follow up once the credit note is signed; expect the draft in your inbox within the hour.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
